extraction.notes: Current-quarter (three months ended March 31, 2024) column only. Subtotals verified: 142,827 + adjustments = 288,436 FFO; 288,436 + adjustments = 266,169 Core FFO; 266,169 - 18,934 = 247,235 Core AFFO. Per-share check: 288,436/119,857=2.41; 266,169/119,857=2.22; 247,235/119,857=2.06. The gain on sale of non-depreciable real estate and the mark-to-market debt adjustment are shown as '—' (zero) for Q1 2024; they are included at 0 because they are printed lines. Mark-to-market debt adjustment categorized as 'other' since it is a debt fair-value amortization item not matching a listed category. AFFO subtracts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Redevelopment, revenue-enhancing, commercial and other capex lines appear after Core AFFO (in the FAD section) and were not included in the AFFO total.
